answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks through stake-weighted graph attestations. A new node must bond verifiable compute and secure vouching links within an established peer grove. For an attacker, creating millions of fake identities requires compounding financial stakes with zero marginal yield, making mass spam economically unfeasible. Authentic transactions leave an immutable cryptographic pigment on the ledger, while an unvouched fake node remains an isolated relic lacking voting rights.
